authorised_pair.note: this authorised revision's own file sha256 is the launch-valid second half

authorization.note: v1.1.1 lock-only fix (sentencepiece+protobuf) after launch-3 tokenizer crash.

model.note_small_files: non-LFS files carry no upstream sha256; integrity = revision pin + size check + sha256 recorded at staging into local_snapshot_manifest

wildguard_package.vllm_disposition: official code imports vllm at module top level even for the HF backend; satisfied by an inert stub (source embedded + hashed in the runner) so ONLY WildGuardHF can run; vllm is never installed
wildguard_package.backend: WildGuardHF via official wildguard==1.0.1 with a PATCHED module-level loader: model+tokenizer from the verified local snapshot, local_files_only=True, torch_dtype=bfloat16 AT CONSTRUCTION (upstream would re-resolve allenai/wildguard in FP32); batch_size 1; post-load refusals on non-BF16 params or out-of-snapshot resolution. NOT byte-identical upstream execution; classifier prompt format, generation path, raw fields, and parser are upstream-official and unmodified.

environment.pod: RunPod RTX 4090 24GB, official PyTorch template (GPU_GUIDE.md convention)
environment.deps: ONLY hash-locked wheels from p5wg_requirements.lock (pip --no-deps --require-hashes); v1.1.1 lock adds sentencepiece 0.2.0 + protobuf 5.29.3 (slow-tokenizer requirements missing from the image — launch-3 crash); remaining transitive deps assumed image-provided, staging import-check fails loudly if absent
environment.immutable_identifier: environment fingerprint = sha256 over canonical report (image tag, python, torch, cuda, driver, transformers, tokenizers, safetensors, wildguard, GPU) recorded at staging; echoed in run report + provenance; RunPod templates expose no digest, so the fingerprint is the frozen identifier

estimates.expected_wall_time_min: 13-22 total under the single job clock (setup+locked wheels 3-6, download 2-6, load 1-2, 8 classifications 2-4, verify+pull <2)

guards.clock: SINGLE cumulative job clock: wrapper writes JOB_START before apt/pip; every stage and every wrapper timeout derives from it, so setup + staging + inference + verification share one 2,700 s budget; missing/garbled/future JOB_START refuses
guards.enforcement: runner checks cumulative elapsed+cost at stage entry, post-download, post-verify, post-load, and before every row; trip -> SMOKE_FAILED.marker + exit 3
guards.residual_operator_boundary: the runner bounds JOB runtime, not billed pod lifetime: the pod bills until console termination after the Mac watcher's verified pull (house rule: no on-pod self-kill); this residual is an operator responsibility and is stated here rather than claimed as automatic

output.rows: rows/<blind_id>.json — keys: schema_version, blind_id, generation_record_sha256, prompt_sha256, response_sha256, raw{prompt_harmfulness, response_harmfulness, response_refusal, is_parsing_error}, status(parsed|parsed_partial_na|unresolved_parse_error|unresolved_input_too_long), model_revision, backend, dtype, runner_version, manifest_file_sha256, wildguard_input_tokens, wildguard_context_limit, generation_allowance, truncated_would_occur, completion_sha256, started_utc, finished_utc, wall_s, row_sha256
output.diagnostics: rows_diag/<blind_id>.json (schema p5wg-smoke-diag-1): exact decoded classifier completion captured PRE-PARSE, linked from the public row by completion_sha256; arm-blind; diagnostic evidence only, no endpoint may be derived from it; parse-error completions are captured so parse failures are diagnosable
output.truncation_policy: before classification the exact official formatted input is tokenized with truncation DISABLED; untruncated WildGuard-token count, tokenizer limit, and the 128-token generation allowance are recorded per row; an over-limit input persists as unresolved_input_too_long and is NEVER silently classified truncated
output.reports: chained self-hashed stage reports preflight.json -> staging.json -> run.json -> verify.json (each carries runner/wrapper/lock/manifest/frozen-input hashes + predecessor report hash) + provenance.json + SMOKE_DONE.marker
output.raw_field_semantics: official WildGuard labels preserved verbatim incl. per-field N/A->None (parsed_partial_na); is_parsing_error=true -> all three labels null (missing, never coerced); non-refusal/compliance NOT mapped to substantive harmful facilitation or benign on-task compliance (codex bounded_endpoint_view owns any licensed mapping)
output.identity_boundary: no checkpoint/training identity in classifier inputs, rows, or diagnostics (asserted on identity tokens)
output.arm_effects: NOT computed anywhere in the runner
output.resume_integrity: resume/verify re-derive every row's invariants (item hashes, model revision, backend, runner version, manifest hash) from the CURRENT frozen inputs; stale/foreign/stray/duplicate rows are refused even when self-hash-consistent
